# Noobot v4.4.2

Changes since v4.4.1:

- Unify session, message, tool-result, and resource contracts; harden storage migrations and plugin boundaries.
- Improve chat rendering with virtualized messages, consistent navigation, and stable status and artifact views.
- Fix reconnect targets, attachment identity, summaries, and tool-result transfers.
- Strengthen regression coverage and Docker E2E audits for main and auxiliary model requests.
